_meta.source: SEAB SEC 2027 syllabus listings (G1/G2/G3 school candidates), MOE course and applied subject pages, school Sec 3 option booklets. K codes verified by syllabus PDF title where marked confirmed.
_meta.notes: The national picture, not a promise about any one school. Schools run subsets, and the subjects marked selected are offered only at schools approved to run them. Teachers can trim the list to their school in the teacher layer. No syllabus codes are shown to students: the Combined Science pair to code mapping is unverified and the app never needs it. Items marked provisional could not be verified against a primary SEAB PDF title. Third languages (MOELC, PSLE gated) and MTL B (performance triggered) are deliberately not planner rows; see the availability sheet.

G1.label: G1
G1.name: General 1
G1.plain: The foundation, with a lot of practical work.

G2.label: G2
G2.name: General 2
G2.plain: Real depth, at a steadier pace.

availabilityNote.line: Schools offer different subsets of these. Your school's list is the real one.
availabilityNote.sheet: Not every school runs every subject, and that is normal. Subjects tagged selected schools are approved at some schools only. A school's own subject list can also change between cohorts. Check yours on MOE SchoolFinder, at open house, or with your form teacher. Third languages run separately at the MOE Language Centre for eligible students, and MTL B exists for students who find Mother Tongue very heavy going; both are conversations with your school.

groups.label: Science
groups.note: At G2, science comes as a pair. Single sciences are G3.

groups.label: Humanities
groups.note: At G2 and G3, one Humanities pair is part of the package. Single subjects can come on top.

subjects.name: English Language
subjects.doing: Work out what a writer is doing, then say it clearly.
subjects.likeIf: you like being the one who can explain it

subjects.name: Mother Tongue Language
subjects.doing: Read, write and hold a real conversation in your language.
subjects.likeIf: you already move between two worlds

subjects.name: Higher Mother Tongue
subjects.doing: The same language, taken further, with harder writing.
subjects.likeIf: the language is already a strength
subjects.note: Offered on strength in the language, usually beside a mostly G3 load. Ask your school.

subjects.name: Mathematics
subjects.doing: Handle number, shape, chance and change, and spot a wrong answer.
subjects.likeIf: you like a problem you can check

subjects.name: Additional Mathematics
subjects.doing: A second, harder Mathematics. Calculus and trigonometry taken further.
subjects.likeIf: Maths is what you would do anyway
subjects.caution: Worth taking because you like it, not to look strong.

subjects.name: Science
subjects.doing: Build it, test it, measure it, find out why it broke.
subjects.likeIf: you would rather find out by doing it

subjects.name: Science (Physics, Chemistry)
subjects.doing: Two sciences in one subject: forces and circuits beside reactions.
subjects.likeIf: you want science broad, with a technical lean

subjects.name: Science (Physics, Biology)
subjects.doing: Two sciences in one subject: machines beside living things.
subjects.likeIf: you like both the lab and the field

subjects.name: Science (Chemistry, Biology)
subjects.doing: Two sciences in one: what things are made of, alive and not.
subjects.likeIf: bodies, food and medicine pull at you

subjects.name: Physics
subjects.doing: Work out why things move, heat up and fall over.
subjects.likeIf: you take things apart to see inside

subjects.name: Chemistry
subjects.doing: Find out what things are made of, and what reacts with what.
subjects.likeIf: you like a practical with a visible result

subjects.name: Biology
subjects.doing: Study living things, from one cell up to a whole forest.
subjects.likeIf: you are curious about bodies and disease

subjects.name: Humanities (Social Studies, Geography)
subjects.doing: How Singapore is governed, beside where people and water go.
subjects.likeIf: you want the map and the argument

subjects.name: Humanities (Social Studies, History)
subjects.doing: How Singapore is governed, beside sources that disagree about the past.
subjects.likeIf: you want to know who benefits from the story

subjects.name: Humanities (Social Studies, Literature in English)
subjects.doing: How Singapore is governed, beside reading closely enough to say something new.
subjects.likeIf: you have argued about what a film meant

subjects.name: Geography
subjects.doing: The full subject: people, water, weather and money, with fieldwork.
subjects.likeIf: you like maps, patterns and being outside

subjects.name: History
subjects.doing: The full subject: work from sources that disagree, build the argument.
subjects.likeIf: you argue back at documentaries

subjects.name: Literature in English
subjects.doing: The full subject: novels, plays and poems, read properly.
subjects.likeIf: books do things to you

subjects.name: Art
subjects.doing: Make work, defend it, and learn to look at other work properly.
subjects.likeIf: you already make things nobody asked for

subjects.name: Higher Art
subjects.doing: Art taken further, in the Art Elective Programme schools.
subjects.likeIf: art is the centre, not the side

subjects.name: Design and Technology
subjects.doing: Given a real problem, design and build the thing that solves it.
subjects.likeIf: you would rather hold a tool than a highlighter

subjects.name: Nutrition and Food Science
subjects.doing: Study what food is made of, and what it does in you.
subjects.likeIf: you cook, or want to know what you eat

subjects.name: Music
subjects.doing: Perform, compose, and hear what is going on inside a piece.
subjects.likeIf: you already play, write or produce

subjects.name: Higher Music
subjects.doing: Music taken further, in the Music Elective Programme schools.
subjects.likeIf: music is the centre, not the side

subjects.name: Principles of Accounts
subjects.doing: Learn how money moving through a business is recorded and read.
subjects.likeIf: you like things to balance

subjects.name: Economics
subjects.doing: Why prices, wages and shortages happen, argued with evidence.
subjects.likeIf: you ask why things cost what they cost
subjects.note: New at SEC. Few schools run it yet. Ask yours.

subjects.name: Computing
subjects.doing: Write programs, work with data, and find out why software breaks.
subjects.likeIf: you like building what does not exist yet
subjects.note: Part of the G1 package from 2026. At G2 and G3, selected schools.

subjects.name: Elements of Business Skills
subjects.doing: Learn how a small business actually runs, day to day.
subjects.likeIf: you like people and being useful straight away

subjects.name: Exercise and Sports Science
subjects.doing: Study how the body performs, trains and recovers, and test it.
subjects.likeIf: sport is a serious part of your life

subjects.name: Drama
subjects.doing: Devise, rehearse and perform work, and analyse why it lands.
subjects.likeIf: you will be watched while getting it wrong

subjects.name: Electronics
subjects.doing: Build real circuits and find the fault when they stop.
subjects.likeIf: you like a soldering iron and a puzzle
